QuestInfo.name: Helping JM with His Problem
QuestInfo.0: Time to gently interrogate the people of Kerning City, as Ryden instructed. Talk to #bJM#k.
QuestInfo.1:
JM says one of his customers has asked for a #bThin Jr. Necki Skin#k, but he can't leave his store unattended. Head to the #bSwamp Region#k and bring back a Thin Jr. Necki Skin for him.

Tip: You can get the item required from #p1055002# in #m103050300#.
QuestInfo.2: He gladly revealed that the Dark Lord receives a Delivery Package from someone every week. Interesting...
